claims.text: Intrathecal baclofen (GABA agonist): effective for reflex spasms, but no clear advantage over benzodiazepines
claims.quote: Intrathecal baclofen (a GABAA agonist) is effective in treating reflex spasms but has no clear advantage over benzodiazepines.

claims.text: Dantrolene: by infusion at first, then for up to 60 days; hepatotoxicity and expense limit its use
claims.quote: Dantrolene can be given initially by infusion and thereafter for up to 60 days. Hepatotoxicity and expense limit its use.
